data.name: Choose a question from the bank or upload your own score.
data.value: 從題庫中選擇題目，或上傳您自己的樂譜。

data.name: Failed to load the custom score:
Hear a short musical context, focus on one marked measure, and choose its matching notation. Three or four plausible versions, one clear listening task. No account needed.
data.value: 聆聽一小段音樂，聚焦在標示的小節，並選出相符的樂譜。提供三或四個看似合理的版本，聆聽任務簡單明確。無需帳號即可使用。

data.name: LISTEN · NOTICE · UNDERSTAND
data.value: 聆聽 · 察覺 · 理解

data.name: Listen carefully and select the matching notation below.
data.value: 請仔細聆聽，並從下方選出對應的樂譜記號。

data.name: No pre-defined questions available. Please use the upload option.
data.value: 目前沒有預設的問題。請使用上傳功能。

data.name: One note or one rhythm pattern — no search for scattered mistakes
data.value: 一個音符或一種節奏型態——不必尋找零散的錯誤

data.name: Only the target measure is shown. All versions differ at the same location; the source version is not always the answer.
data.value: 僅顯示目標小節。所有版本都在同一位置有所不同；原始版本不一定是正確答案。

data.name: Please upload a music score before starting.
data.value: 請在開始前先上傳樂譜。

data.name: Please upload a score with at least 4 measures.
data.value: 請上傳一份至少包含 4 小節的樂譜。

data.name: Replay the recording as needed. Select one answer and submit; your first submitted answer counts. Notation and explanation remain available for learning afterward.
data.value: 可視需要重播錄音。選擇一個答案並提交；第一次提交的答案會列入計分。提交後仍可查看樂譜與解說，以供學習。

data.name: Score must have at least 4 measures.
There are no published listening questions yet. Come back after a musician has reviewed the first set.
data.value: 目前尚無已發布的聆聽題目。請等音樂家審閱完第一批題目後再回來。

data.name: Which score matches the recording?
data.value: 哪一個樂譜與錄音相符？
